# Taskade

> Taskade is an AI-native productivity platform: real-time collaborative workspaces, custom AI agents, trigger-and-action automations, and Taskade Genesis — a no-code builder that turns natural-language prompts into live web apps with databases, logins, and custom domains.

Developers can build on the REST API v1, the action-based Public API v2, a TypeScript SDK (preview), webhooks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Full documentation lives at https://docs.taskade.com.

## Quick Start

- [Quick Start Guide](https://docs.taskade.com/quick-start/getting-started): Build your first AI-powered app with Taskade Genesis, then add AI agents, automations, and the developer API.

## Platform

- [Workspace DNA](https://docs.taskade.com/platform/workspace-dna): The three-pillar architecture behind every Taskade workspace and Genesis app — Memory, Intelligence, and Execution.

## Taskade Genesis

- [Taskade Genesis Overview](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis): Turn natural-language prompts into full applications — databases, interfaces, automations, and AI agents — deployed instantly.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/getting-started): Build your first app in 5 minutes from a plain-English prompt, then test, refine, and publish.
- [Examples & Templates](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/examples-and-templates): Proven prompts for CRMs, booking systems, forms, and landing pages, plus 70+ live app templates to fork.
- [How Taskade Genesis Works](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/how-genesis-works): How prompts become live apps using Workspace DNA, Taskade EVE, and the Intelligence Score.
- [Prompt Guide](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/prompt-guide): 12 principles for writing better Genesis prompts — objectives, outcomes, tools, access, iteration.
- [Adding Context](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/adding-context): Upload brand files, data, and reference docs so Genesis builds on-brand apps.
- [Version History](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/version-history): View, compare, and restore app versions with auto vs manual publish controls and Code View.
- [App Analytics](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/app-analytics): Track visitors, pageviews, bounce rate, traffic sources, and devices for any published app.
- [Debugging Genesis Apps](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/debugging-genesis-apps): Classify failures and diagnose import, routing, schema, and namespace bugs.
- [GitHub Import & Export](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/genesis/github-import-export): Two-way, version-controlled app sync with GitHub via branch-and-PR flows.
- [Space Apps Guide](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/space-apps-guide): Publish Genesis apps as real products with custom domains, branding, and advanced features.
- [Prompt Library](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/space-apps-guide/genesis-prompt-library): Copy-paste prompts by business function — CRM, ops, sales, scheduling — plus styling tips.
- [Advanced Features](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/space-apps-guide/advanced-features): Smart data structures, agent training, multi-step automations, integrations, and access control.
- [Custom Domains](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/space-apps-guide/custom-domains): Connect your own branded domain to a published app — DNS setup and SSL.
- [App Secrets & External API Calls](https://docs.taskade.com/taskade-genesis/space-apps-guide/app-secrets): Store API keys in a per-space vault; real credentials never leave the server.

## Run Your Business on Genesis

- [Run Your Business on Genesis](https://docs.taskade.com/run-your-business-on-genesis/run-your-business): Build and run a real business on Genesis — ops dashboard, CRM, or client portal — with logins and your own domain.
- [From Idea to Live Business](https://docs.taskade.com/run-your-business-on-genesis/run-your-business/from-idea-to-live-business): Go live in five steps: describe it, shape your data, add login, brand your domain, launch.
- [Build a Client or Member Portal](https://docs.taskade.com/run-your-business-on-genesis/run-your-business/build-a-client-portal): A portal where each client logs in and sees only their own info — no code.
- [Build an Internal Ops Dashboard](https://docs.taskade.com/run-your-business-on-genesis/run-your-business/build-an-ops-dashboard): An internal dashboard, CRM, or pipeline connected to live workspace data.
- [Add Login & Roles](https://docs.taskade.com/run-your-business-on-genesis/run-your-business/add-login-and-roles): Secure sign-in and access control without a third-party auth provider.
- [Go-Live Checklist](https://docs.taskade.com/run-your-business-on-genesis/run-your-business/go-live-checklist): Secrets, logins, domain, and credits — everything to check before launching to real users.

## AI Features

- [AI Features Overview](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features): Custom AI agents with persistent memory, knowledge, and tool access — the intelligence layer of every workspace.
- [AI Agents Getting Started](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/ai-agents-getting-started): Create, train, and deploy agents that read your docs, answer questions, and run tasks.
- [TSK-1 Model Tiers](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/tsk-1-model-tiers): TSK-1 (Taskade System Kernel), the vendor-agnostic AI orchestration layer that auto-routes work across capability tiers — Instant, Standard, Thinking, Reasoning, plus Auto.
- [Agent Knowledge & Memory](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/agent-knowledge): Train agents on PDFs, CSVs, docs, URLs, YouTube, or live auto-updating projects.
- [Tools for AI Agents](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/agent-tools): Native tools, Slack/Gmail/HubSpot integrations, custom automation tools, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
- [AI Agent Teams](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/agent-teams): Teams of agents where Taskade picks the best-qualified agent to respond.
- [Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/multi-agents): Specialized agents collaborating on projects, with Taskade EVE orchestrating handoffs.
- [Image Generation](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/image-generation): Generate images in EVE chat with prompt templates, auto-saved to Media.
- [Media AI Chat](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/media-ai-chat): Chat with files, projects, and media — extract insights and generate content.
- [Autopilot](https://docs.taskade.com/ai-features/ai-features/autopilot): Turn one prompt into a full workspace of connected projects, agents, teams, and automations.

## Automations

- [Automations Overview](https://docs.taskade.com/automations/automation): The trigger-and-action engine — 100+ integrations with AI agents running workflows end to end.
- [AI Forms](https://docs.taskade.com/automations/automation/ai-forms): Forms with smart validation, sentiment analysis, and conditional questions that auto-route responses.
- [Action & Trigger Reference](https://docs.taskade.com/automations/automation/actions): Complete action reference — create tasks, run agents, send HTTP requests, chain steps.
- [Workflow Generator](https://docs.taskade.com/automations/automation/workflow-generator): Build complex automations from plain English — triggers, branches, loops, integrations.
- [Integration Overview](https://docs.taskade.com/automations/automation/comprehensive-integration-guide): Connect Slack, Gmail, HubSpot, Sheets, and more, plus custom HTTP and webhook integrations.
- [Integration Options](https://docs.taskade.com/automations/automation/integrations): Triggers and actions for 100+ tools, plus custom webhook integrations.
- [Automation Recipes](https://docs.taskade.com/automations/automation/recipes): Ready-to-use recipes with full JSON configs — publishing, lead capture, ticket routing, GitHub sync.

## Workspaces

- [Workspaces Overview](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces): Projects, tasks, members, and billing — the structured-data foundation for apps, agents, and automations.
- [Projects & Databases](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/projects-databases): Database projects with custom fields, relationships, and 9 views; how Genesis auto-generates schemas.
- [Project Views](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/project-views): Switch the same data between List, Board, Table, Calendar, Mind Map, Gantt, and more.
- [Teams](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/teams): Workspace and folder structures with a 5-role RBAC permission system.
- [Collaboration](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/collaboration): Live co-editing, chat, comments, video calls, presence, and AI summaries.
- [Markdown Support](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/markdown): Full Markdown syntax reference across the editor, chat, comments, and import/export.
- [Import](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/import): Import Markdown, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, and more as projects, agent knowledge, or app context.
- [Embed](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/embed): Embed projects and Genesis apps on any site via iframe.
- [Knowledge Management](https://docs.taskade.com/workspaces/workspaces/knowledge-management): Organize knowledge sources to power smarter agents, with bulk import and the Agents API.

- [Community & Sharing](https://docs.taskade.com/community-and-sharing/community-and-sharing): Share, publish, and clone apps and templates — for your team or the community.
- [Publish & Clone](https://docs.taskade.com/community-and-sharing/community-and-sharing/publish-and-clone): Live URLs, password protection, custom domains, SEO, white-label branding, and paid copies.
- [GenesisAuth](https://docs.taskade.com/community-and-sharing/community-and-sharing/genesis-auth): No-code user accounts and sign-in for Genesis apps — App Users, workspace SSO, custom-domain login.
- [Best Practices](https://docs.taskade.com/community-and-sharing/community-and-sharing/best-practices): Write effective prompts, test on mobile, iterate one change at a time.
- [FAQ](https://docs.taskade.com/community-and-sharing/community-and-sharing/faq): How the no-code builder works — build times, publishing, data ownership, security, pricing.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.taskade.com/community-and-sharing/community-and-sharing/troubleshooting): Fix an app that missed the mark — sharpen prompts, add features, resolve context-limit errors.

## Developers

- [Developer Platform](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/developer-home): Everything you need to build on Taskade — REST API v1, Action API v2, MCP servers, OAuth 2.0, and webhooks.
- [Developer Overview](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/developer-home/developers): The developer surface at a glance — APIs, tokens, MCP, webhooks, and Genesis app generation.
- [Authentication](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/authentication): Personal Access Tokens for scripts and MCP; OAuth 2.0 with PKCE for third-party apps.
- [Personal Tokens](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/authentication/personal-tokens): Generate a Personal Access Token and authenticate with the Authorization Bearer header.
- [REST API v1 Reference](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/comprehensive-api-guide): Manage workspaces, projects, tasks, agents, folders, and media with full CRUD and code examples.
- [Action API v2 Reference](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/api-v2-reference): The action-based (RPC-over-HTTP) Public API v2 — every call is a POST to a named operation.
- [TypeScript SDK (Preview)](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/sdk-quickstart): Call the API today with plain HTTP, and what the generated client will look like.
- [SDK Cookbook](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/sdk-quickstart/sdk-cookbook): Integration patterns — agents, automations, projects, bundles, error handling, pagination, testing.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/webhooks): Inbound webhooks to trigger automations and signed outbound webhooks over the Public API v2.
- [Bundles & App Kits](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/bundles): Export and import complete Genesis apps and workspaces as portable bundles via the Action API v2.
- [Long-Term Memory](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/long-term-memory): Memory that lives as real Projects — editable, browsable, and API-addressable.
- [Autonomous Agents](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/autonomous-agents): Agents that run without per-request prompting — automations, orchestration, and Autopilot patterns.
- [REST API v1 live OpenAPI spec](https://www.taskade.com/api/documentation/v1): Interactive reference (JSON: https://www.taskade.com/api/documentation/v1/json).
- [Action API v2 live OpenAPI spec](https://www.taskade.com/api/documentation/v2): Interactive reference (JSON: https://www.taskade.com/api/documentation/v2/json).

## MCP

- [Which Taskade MCP do I want?](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/mcp-overview): Three MCP surfaces, one decision — Workspace MCP (@taskade/mcp-server) for task writes, the hosted Taskade MCP for orchestration, or MCP Connectors for agent tool access.
- [Workspace MCP](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/workspace-mcp): Connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, and more to your workspace via @taskade/mcp-server.
- [Workspace MCP: Advanced](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/workspace-mcp/workspace-mcp-advanced): Rate limits, multi-client setup, troubleshooting, and security for production use.
- [Run Your Live App by Talking to Claude](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/workspace-mcp/run-your-app-with-ai): Run your Genesis app's day-to-day data through conversation — no IDs, no API code.
- [Hosted Taskade MCP (Beta)](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/workspace-mcp/genesis-app-mcp): Orchestrate your workspace from any MCP client via https://www.taskade.com/mcp (OAuth 2.0) — create projects, manage and prompt agents, and edit your Genesis app's source.
- [MCP Connectors](https://docs.taskade.com/developers/mcp-connectors): Connect Genesis apps and AI agents to 31+ external services using the Model Context Protocol.
